was The Wavelength Gale. The Gale installed a small landing beacon at the top of Mount Vorena, the tallest peak on the world. The base of The Wavelength Gale is located in a cove that can be reached only by traveling on foot through winding caverns that begin near the base of Mount Vorena. The Gale's leader picked that site for a reason.
